name: solana-mcp-vybe
description: Live Solana market, token, wallet, and API tools from Vybe.

interface.shortDescription: Explore live Solana tokens, traders, markets, and wallets.
interface.longDescription:
Solana MCP by Vybe connects Codex to Vybe’s live Solana data and API toolkit: wallets, trades, markets, PnL, transfers, on-chain activity, signable swaps, and endpoint discovery. Ask for a wallet’s balances, realized and unrealized PnL, counterparties, or token holdings; look up token prices, holders, liquidity, and candles; scan markets, DEX activity, trade history, and transfers; or pull top traders and labeled accounts without leaving Codex.

Browse the Vybe API catalog, inspect an endpoint’s parameters, then run authenticated live queries and get real results back. When you need a swap, the server can return an unsigned transaction to sign in your own wallet. Connect with OAuth at https://mcp.vybenetwork.xyz/mcp. It does not take private keys, and it does not broadcast transactions for you.
